products.name: Javana Royal Villas
products.description: With a stay at Javana Royal Villas in Seminyak (Kuta Utara), you'll be within a 5-minute drive of Petitenget Temple and Seminyak Square. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A shuttle from the airport to the hotel is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free valet parking is available onsite.

products.name: Villa Rene
products.description: Located in Seminyak (Kuta Utara), this villa is within a 5-minute drive of Batu Belig Beach and TAKSU Bali Gallery. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite.

products.name: Kamala 555
products.description: With a stay at Kamala 555 in Kamala, you'll be steps from Kamala Beach and a 2-minute drive from Phuket Fantasea. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Free self parking is available onsite.

products.name: Best Western West Hotel
products.description: With a stay at Best Western West Hotel in Oslo (Central Oslo), you'll be within a 10-minute walk of National Library and Royal Palace. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services.
